integrity: The projective-local computation is exact over the rationals. Finite symbolic calculations are used only for polynomial identities and valuations; no finite experiment is used as a proof of an infinite assertion.
scientific_limitations: The six affine node types are taken from the exact proof in Fomin--Shustin Example 8.4; the new verification focuses on the projective point at infinity and reproduces the displayed self-intersection resultant. No classification beyond this named sextic is claimed.
title: A hidden \(A_8\) point at infinity on the six-node expressive sextic
